Real AMI transcripts captured from ASL3 nodes with tools/capture-ami.sh.

- `asl3-22.10.1-node.txt`: ASL3 3.10.8 / Asterisk 22.10.1 captured from a live ASL3 node.
  Two local nodes (a SimpleUSB node and an idle USRP node), one outbound
  transceive link into a large network (159 linked nodes), with keying and a
  link drop/reconnect. Condensed from the original capture (repeated events
  removed); peer IPs and other operators' callsigns replaced with placeholders.
